opening.argument: The video provides a concrete Windows 8.1 settings procedure: viewers are directed to the Search settings menu, shown that Bing online search is enabled, and instructed to disable it and clear the search history. The steps are specific and verifiable, including the instruction to “Click on Clear again to confirm.” The iYogi contact information is presented as an expert-support promotion, while the subscription prompt is framed as an invitation for more helpful tech videos. These are separate support and channel-engagement promotions accompanying a technology tutorial, with no stated connection to a deceptive financial solicitation.

citations.quote: To display the Bing integration go to the CHARMS search menu. Select Settings, and then type search in the search box.
Here you can see that the option Use Bing to Search Online is on. To turn this feature off click on the slider button.
Click on Clear again to confirm.
